Waves rok nahi sakte, surf seekh sakte.
Best thinking heart se aata.
Sahi waqt par sab mil jayega.
Positive raho, hard kaam karo, make it happen.
Magic nahi—sab mindset aur effort hai.
Wait mat karo; time kabhi perfect nahi hoga.
Sabse achha badla bada safalta hai.
Agar sirf mind me turn karoge, field plow kabhi nahi hoga.
Jitna mehnat karoge, utna hi kismet aapke saath hogi.
Tumhari choices future shape karti.
"Dictionary me hi work se pehle success aata."
"Act na kare toh opportunities miss."
Naye goal ke liye koi umar nahi.
